nodes.label: Composite Layup Workspace
nodes.description: Lab workspace showing composite tube/airframe layup activity. A long carbon fiber or fiberglass tube is visible on the bench alongside microscopes (QMAX brand), cut fabric/material scraps, laser-cut wooden rings, and assorted lab tools. Indicates active composite fabrication and quality inspection process.

nodes.label: GMPR Composite Rocket Project
nodes.description: The GMPR (Get Me to the Podium Rocket or similar) composite rocket project. Involves composite airframe fabrication, nosecone cap design (CAD + prototyping), and structural component development.
